notes: Only CO2 combustion emissions, not all greenhouse gases. Transport now represents full 1.A.3 via the road/domestic-marine proxy. Town-gas manufacture and industrial processes remain outside covered sectors.
Emission factors: EPD 2010 buildings guidelines Table 1-1 (town gas); IPCC 2006 Volume 2 Chapter 1 Tables 1.2 and 1.4 (NCVs and CO2 factors).
Town gas uses observed gross heat: 2.549 kg CO2 per 48 MJ. Do not add the supplier production emission factor.

Fuel densities, LPG NCV/GCV ratio, power efficiencies, pooled oil/gas split, vehicle fuel intensities and EV mileage ratios are explicit unvalidated model assumptions. Scenario min/max is not a confidence interval.
Recent non-gas fuel emissions may be extrapolated from the last complete annual fuel benchmark using monthly activity; marked Modelled, never Measured or Benchmark-constrained.
No future months are filled. 2026 results are partial-year only.
historical_industry_calibration: 2021 CRT only; annual EMSD non-electric fuel energy ratio; 2005 and 2020 held out for validation

transport_proxy.passenger_marine: TD table 2.1 Ferries passenger journeys; calendar days before 2013
transport_proxy.residual_transport: follow road activity only; assigned entirely to Road Transport
transport_proxy.outside_annual_marine_coverage: after 2024: passenger energy per ferry passenger; freight energy per day; before 2008: missing
transport_proxy.scope: IPCC 1.A.3 direct combustion CO2; excludes international bunker fuels and rail electricity
transport_proxy.published_scope: Road Transport = 1.A.3.b plus residual 1.A.3.a/c/e; Domestic Navigation = 1.A.3.d; sum preserves full 1.A.3
transport_proxy.early_road_residual: All years: road plus residual follows calibrated road index independently of navigation

official_baseline.history: All sectors use 2021 CRT baseline; 2005 and 2020 are validation years
official_baseline.scope_assumption: Statistical activity and supplied-fuel boundaries proxy the matching CRT category; calibration does not resolve changes in boundary or fuel intensity
official_baseline.release: official baseline with quarterly-activity nowcasts and validated power intensity scenarios

near_realtime.company_update_note: Fuel-class sent-out mix proxy, HKE coal includes oil; coefficients are sensitivity assumptions, not measured plant emission factors
near_realtime.backtest_note: Pseudo out-of-sample on revised cached data, prior periods only; source release vintages unavailable

industry.extrapolation: hold latest annual fuel / monthly activity annual sum ratio
